remarks: This Split-level Ranch, in the desirable Newfield neighborhood, has been meticulously maintained and is ready for its new owners to enjoy. It was thoughtfully designed, providing a spacious, sun-filled layout that effortlessly blends relaxation and entertainment. Nestled on a park-like lot, this 3 bedroom, 2 bath is an exceptional blend of comfort and style. With formal and informal spaces on the main floor, the home allows for hosting and unwinding depending on your mood. Enjoy the exposed beams of the family room while relaxing by the fireplace on a winter day or a pleasant afternoon doing crossword puzzles on the covered porch overlooking the backyard. The expansive lot allows for endless outdoor possibilities and plenty of room for play. Upstairs you'll find the large primary bedroom with a full bath and two additional bedrooms. The lower level is versatile and can be used as a playroom or office and has an additional storage room. Conveniently located, this home is just minutes from all of Stamford's amenities.
